description: Find which sections of one chapter of a Texas code mention a keyword, e.g. Insurance Code (IN) chapter 544 (prohibited discrimination) with query "age condition", or chapter 2210 (windstorm association) with "roof". Returns each matching section with its citation, heading and a text excerpt around the first hit (use tx_statute for the full text). Reads ONE chapter per call (one publisher fetch from the Texas Legislative Council, kept in memory for an hour); there is no code-wide search, so name the chapter. match "all" (default) needs every word in the section, "any" needs one; words match whole words with a plural, -ed or -ing ending, so "roof" finds roofs and roofing but "age" does not match "agent". Keyless.

chapter.description: Chapter number as cited, e.g. "544" (Insurance Code, prohibited discrimination) or "19".

code.description: Texas code abbreviation, e.g. "IN" (Insurance), "PE" (Penal), "FA" (Family), "BC" (Business and Commerce). Call tx_codes to see them.

match.description: "all" (default): every word must appear in the section. "any": at least one.

query.description: One or more words to look for in the section text, e.g. "roof" or "age condition".

name: tx_statute_search
title: Tx Statute Search
